data.name: Zachary
data.gender_notes: Zachary is used as a male name in christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Hebrew Zekharyah, 'God has remembered'. Its root is Hebrew z-k-r-y-h. Zechariah, father of John the Baptist (Luke 1). Zachary is a Hebrew name meaning “God remembers”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Zachary expresses “God remembers”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Hebrew Zekharyah, 'God has remembered'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Zachary total 37, reducing to 1. Number 1 is associated with leadership, independence and initiative.
